name: map_places
title: Asked to put deals on a map, Alpha proposes making the city field a place field

steps.say: put my map deals on a map by their city
steps.reply:
I've proposed turning the City field into a map location. Once you approve it, Alpha will place all three deals on the map:

- Deli: Mumbai, India
- Cafe: Paris, France
- Bakery: Austin, TX

The cities are the ones you gave me. Nothing changes until you say yes.

checks.why: 1 proposed entry: Show Map deals on a map: make City a place field.

checks.arg: Did Alpha say it proposed making City a place field, for the person to approve, rather than claiming the map is already done?
checks.why: The answer says Alpha 'proposed turning the City field into a map location', that it will be placed 'once you approve it', and that 'Nothing changes until you say yes', so it does not claim the map is already done.
